record.paper_title: Achievement sets – current results and open problems
record.context_brief: Compact realizability of centers of distances
record.original_question: If C ⊂ [0,∞) is compact and contains 0, must there exist a compact set K ⊂ ℝ whose center of distances satisfies C(K) = C?

evidence.quote: Assume 0 ∈ C ⊆ [0, ∞) is compact. Does there exist a compact K ⊆ R with C(K) = C?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For a nonempty subset A of the metric space (ℝ, |·|), define the center of distances of A by
   C(A) := { t ∈ [0, ∞) : for every x ∈ A there exists y ∈ A with |x − y| = t }.
Note that whenever A is nonempty and compact, C(A) is a compact subset of [0, ∞) containing 0.

Question: Let C ⊂ [0, ∞) be a compact set with 0 ∈ C. Must there exist a compact set K ⊂ ℝ such that C(K) = C?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem appears to be open. It is listed among current open problems concerning achievement sets and centers of distances; while the center of distances is known to be compact for compact sets and to contain 0, no general construction realizing every such compact set as C(K) for some compact K ⊂ ℝ has been published. Recent work (2022–2025) on centers of distances of central Cantor sets and achievement sets continues to address related realizability questions but does not resolve this one.

status_evidence.title: On the center of distances
status_evidence.snippet: Definition of center of distances S(A) and basic property that S(A) is compact when A is compact.
status_evidence.claim: Defines the center of distances and establishes compactness, framing the realizability question.

status_evidence.title: The Center of Distances of Central Cantor Sets
status_evidence.snippet: Recent investigations characterize centers of distances for special classes (central Cantor sets), without giving a general realizability result.
status_evidence.claim: Active research line; no general realizability theorem of arbitrary compact C ⊂ [0,∞) with 0 ∈ C as C(K) is reported.

status_evidence.title: Spectre operator, achievement sets and sets of P-sums
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses achievement sets and centers of distances with several open questions.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates the realizability question remains among open problems in the area.
